data.title: Unit 8: Force, tools, and machines
Types of force
data.text: Click the right option to say whether these sentences are right or wrong.
A force is a push or a pull.
Buoyancy is a force that works in water.
Friction is the force that keeps us on Earth.
The most powerful force of gravity on Earth comes from the Earth itself.
Rough or bumpy surfaces have less friction than smooth or greasy surfaces.
